'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Chris Westergard DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
